description: This Swift source file defines components for previewing session messages in a macOS app, including data models, caching, concurrency control, UI views, and network operations related to session message previews.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: Singleton actor handling caching of session preview snapshots with expiration logic.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: Singleton actor managing concurrent access permits for network requests, preventing over-utilization.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewSnapshot
classes.description: Data structure representing a snapshot of preview items and status for a session menu.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewView
classes.description: SwiftUI View that displays a list of session message previews with various UI states.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewLoader
classes.description: Namespace containing static methods for prewarming, loading, and fetching session preview snapshots, including network request handling and caching.

methods.name: cachedSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a cached snapshot for a session key if it exists and is fresh.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a snapshot in the cache for a given session key.

methods.name: lastSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves the last snapshot for a session key if available.

methods.name: withPermit
methods.description: Acquires a concurrency permit before executing an async operation, releasing it afterward.

methods.name: prewarm
methods.description: Preloads session previews for multiple sessions to warm cache.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a session preview snapshot, using cache if available, otherwise fetching from network.

methods.name: fetchSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches a session preview snapshot, trying preview request first, then history fallback.

methods.name: requestPreview
methods.description: Requests a preview from the server with a timeout.

methods.name: fetchHistorySnapshot
methods.description: Fetches a session message history as a fallback for preview.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot object from a list of preview items or a session entry.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Stores fetched payloads into the cache.

methods.name: previewItems
methods.description: Builds preview items list from session preview entries or chat history payload.

methods.name: decodeMessages
methods.description: Decodes raw message data into message objects.

methods.name: previewRole
methods.description: Determines the preview role based on raw string and whether the message is a tool call.

methods.name: previewText
methods.description: Extracts a displayable text snippet from a message.

methods.name: isToolCall
methods.description: Checks if a message involves a tool call.

methods.name: toolNames
methods.description: Gathers unique tool names from a message.

methods.name: mediaSummary
methods.description: Provides a summary string for media content in a message.

methods.name: dedupePreservingOrder
methods.description: Removes duplicates from an array while preserving order.

methods.name: uniqueKeys
methods.description: Deduplicates and trims whitespace from a list of keys.

methods.name: isUnknownMethodError
methods.description: Identifies specific error conditions indicating unknown methods in server response.
